responsibility: This module implements the Rust front end’s crate metadata interchange layer: it exports a compiled crate’s public interface into Rust-specific metadata records and imports external crate interface data back into the compiler for name resolution and later semantic processing. Its export side walks the crate HIR, filters crate-public items, reconstructs source-like declarations, and serializes them into the .rox/object-embedded metadata format with headers, checksums, and payload framing, while its import side provides the stream abstractions, search-path and file probing logic, object-section and raw metadata readers, and archive scanning needed to locate metadata in standalone files, object files, normal or thin archives, decode crate records, and expose imported crate names and contents. Overall, this directory is the Rust front end’s boundary for publishing and consuming cross-crate API metadata, distinguishing it from parsing, type checking, or code generation modules.
